entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Russian Imperial Period and Nationalism, a transformative movement in Georgia (1810–1918). Emerged from Russia abolishes the Georgian monarchy and directly annexes Kartli-Kakheti and Aga Mohammad Khan of Persia sacks Tbilisi. Catalyzed Georgian Democratic Republic proclaimed in Tbilisi.
